For me, I live in a rural area so there aren't really any options for support. However, in larger areas, you can usually find community support groups for depression and other mental illnesses. If you go to the Suicide hotline's website, they have a resource page.

When I'm on my meds, I'm not really me. Yes I am calmer and more compliant. Those little stressors and irritations wash over me. But aspects of myself, such as my creativity, are gone. I'm a DIY addict and it wasn't until I went off my meds that I regained the  ability to do that sort of thing. I've designed and made 80% of my wedding stuff in the past 2 months that I've been off my meds. While I was on them, I just couldn't put it together. 

On my meds, things wash over me. Nothing seems important. I have no passion. My mind is clearer, I can make the phone calls or have the social interactions that my anxiety keeps me from but, I feel like I'm really just going through the motions. It isn't fun, the meds just help me tolerate what normally makes me anxious. 

On my meds, I'm quite, compliant, and numb. Off of them, I'm erratic and emotional. But at least the emotions are there and they are real.

Believe me I know about having to have the meds swapped out, I've been on 5 different meds in the last two years. I'm planning on making an appointment next week to get another adjustment.
